column1: # The feeds read for "In the news" on /now and the home page's Now card (scripts/news/make-news.js, run by
# .github/workflows/news.yml): name as shown TAB the site TAB the feed TAB a category an item must carry (optional).
# Only the headline, its link, the source's name and the date are taken: never a summary or a picture.
# History and archaeology news only; a mixed feed needs its category. Checked 11 Nov 2026.
